data.body: REVISED: The workflow display name 'Sprint Story Review' is load-bearing — dso.review.check_name=Sprint Story Review (in dso-config.conf) is the GitHub branch-protection required-check context. Changing the workflow name without coordinated ruleset update would break required-check matching. Three options for a real fix: (1) rename workflow + update dso.review.check_name + update all GitHub Rulesets referencing 'Sprint Story Review' — coordinated multi-step migration; (2) leave name as-is, accept the inconsistency with the renamed file; (3) add a SECOND workflow with the new name + sunset period. Recommendation: defer and leave name as-is. Aborting this fix branch. Priority lowered to P5 / WONTFIX-pending-coordination.
